signals.text: 3 open PM roles across 1 US office

bullets: Demonstrate ownership for the products you build and an understanding of shipping services that can perform and scale with Justworks.
Lead discovery into complex, country-specific requirements — pay rates and standard hours, timesheets, overtime calculations, statutory-holiday tracking, and payroll timing — and…
Shape the strategy and roadmap for key Time Global initiatives and articulate a compelling vision of impact on our international business to stakeholders across the product and…
Identify where international needs expose needs in core infrastructure, and partner with adjacent pods to improve the foundation for all customers.
Use customer feedback, data, and competitive research to sequence the roadmap and make clear, well-reasoned prioritization calls.
Embrace complex platform and experience related stakeholder problems
Analyze funnel drop-offs, design and run experiments, work with research to interview customers, and partner with Data Science to define and track activation metrics
Demonstrate expertise in deploying a product strategy and effectively tie insights to roadmap outcomes
Scope, prioritize, and execute projects to deliver measurable business impact while ensuring clarity on objectives, leverage, and accountability for outcomes
Partner deeply with Design and Engineering peers and organize and lead effective team processes and routines
Own and drive the product vision and roadmap for your respective Advisors teams within the Lifecycle mission, consisting of Acquisition and Capabilities squads.
Align strategy and execution by turning company objectives into actionable team goals and OKRs.
Partner deeply with Partnerships, Operations, and Marketing leadership to develop a best-in-class advisor experience and conversion funnel.
Ensure products and features are delivered on time, within scope, and with high quality.
Lead customer-focused product development from ideation to execution while ensuring the customer’s voice guides scope and priorities.
